text: 第三十二次亚太经合组织（APEC）中小企业部长会议4日在广东广州举行，中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理张国清出席开幕式并致辞。 张国清表示，中方愿与各方一道，积极落实四大全球倡议，持续深挖合作潜力，共同打造协同融通的创新生态，营造公平公正的市场环境，构建普惠共享的服务体系，加强务实有效的区域合作，携手推动更多中小企业拔节生长、蓬勃壮大，为构建开放、活力、强韧、和平的亚太共同体贡献积极力量。（新华社）
text_en: The 32nd APEC SME Ministerial Meeting was held in Guangzhou, Guangdong on the 4th. Zhang Guoqing, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, attended and addressed the opening ceremony. Zhang Guoqing stated that China is willing to work with all parties to actively implement the four major global initiatives, continuously explore cooperation potential, jointly build a synergistic and interconnected innovation ecosystem, create a fair and just market environment, build an inclusive and shared service system, strengthen practical and effective regional cooperation, and jointly promote the growth and prosperity of more SMEs, contributing positive strength to building an open, vibrant, resilient, and peaceful Asia-Pacific community. (Xinhua News Agency)
